title: Lost in MST
statementMd:
One day, Colin got lost in a complete undirected graph 𝐺G with 𝑛n vertices, and each vertex 𝑖i is associated with a magic parameter 𝑐𝑖ci. For each pair of vertices (𝑖,𝑗)(i,j), there exists an undirected edge connecting them with weight 𝑤𝑖,𝑗=gcd(𝑐𝑖,𝑐𝑗)+lcm(𝑐𝑖,𝑐𝑗)wi,j=gcd(ci,cj)+lcm(ci,cj).

Can you find the graph's minimum spanning tree 𝐺G to save Colin?

Recall that gcd(𝑥,𝑦)gcd(x,y) is the greatest common divisor of 𝑥x and 𝑦y, and lcm(𝑥,𝑦)lcm(x,y) is the least common multiple of 𝑥x and 𝑦y.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer 𝑛 (1≤𝑛≤105)n (1≤n≤105), representing the number of vertices in the graph.

The second line contains 𝑛n positive integers 𝑐1,𝑐2,⋯,𝑐𝑛 (1≤𝑐𝑖≤106)c1,c2,⋯,cn (1≤ci≤106).

## Output

Output a single line with a single integer, representing the total weight of the edges in the minimum spanning tree of 𝐺G.
